decisions.reason: As a schlager compilation CD close to the firm's established reissue offer, it builds on existing curation and distribution knowledge, so the firm can interpret early results and improve it.
The illustrated music release series builds directly on the firm's established offer and product-line format, leveraging its existing knowledge to learn and expand the collector base.
The reissued jazz vinyl LP aligns closely with the firm's core reissue expertise and vinyl collector market, giving high absorptive capacity to refine and sustain it.
The multi-disc box set is close to the firm's established offer and uses its existing production and curation capabilities, supporting learning and improvement.
The compilation music CD is close to the firm's established offer, though its weaker website presence suggests lower priority, but existing knowledge still supports keeping it.
